format: ECMAScript Module (JavaScript with ES Module syntax, .mjs)
description: This file contains utility functions for handling TypeScript files, such as resolving paths, identifying test files, collecting TypeScript source files from directories, and analyzing call expressions, primarily used for test detection and code analysis in a project workspace.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazily requires and caches the 'typescript' module for later use.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the repository root directory based on the provided import URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Generates absolute source root paths given a repository root and relative root segments.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Checks whether a file path matches known test or harness suffixes.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target directory, optionally including test files and skipping node_modules.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Collects TypeScript files from multiple source root directories.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Reads files and applies a violation-finding function, returning all violations across source roots.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Converts a TypeScript AST node position to a line number in the source file.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts text from property name nodes in AST.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Strips parentheses and type assertions from an expression to get the underlying expression.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Traverses the AST to locate call expressions and records their line numbers.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Checks if the current script is executed directly (not imported) based on process arguments.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Executes a main function if the script is run directly, handling errors appropriately.
